notes: Verified live on the manufacturer's own product page (store.ui.com), which shows a labeled front/rear panel diagram: "(40) GbE, PoE+ RJ45 ports", "(8) GbE, PoE++ RJ45 ports", "(4) 10G SFP+ Ports", "600W total PoE supply", "1.3in touchscreen with AR switch management", "Layer 3 switching features", "Near-silent cooling", "Power input", and a separate "DC power backup" port (requires the optional UniFi Power Backup accessory). Individual RJ45 ports are numbered sequentially on the physical panel (1-48); exact printed numbering for the 4 SFP+ slots was not independently confirmed, so "SFP+ 1-4" naming is inferred (medium confidence on that specific label text only). The rear AC inlet is a standard small IEC-style socket (mapped to "iec"/C13-C14); the "DC power backup" port is actually a proprietary wide multi-pin connector for the UniFi Power Backup unit, not a true barrel jack — "dc-barrel" was chosen as the closest available connector id in the taxonomy. Per-port PoE wattage (up to 30W on the 802.3at PoE+ ports, up to ~90-95W on the 802.3bt PoE++ ports, shared from a 600W total budget) reflects standard Ubiquiti PoE class specs for this switch generation and was not re-verified digit-by-digit on this page. 1U rackmount is standard for the Pro-48 switch family. All Ethernet ports (RJ45 and SFP+) are graded eth-1g / eth-10g for link speed only; PoE class is not a "grade" per the taxonomy and is noted in each port's note field instead.
